_what: Every five minutes reads due_tells() from the person's own history: each person (a thing whose scheme is told_about) with standing new statements whose meanings' tell_after has passed since the newest, batched, with the tell_words for that set of meanings (a cancel and a new booking together are 'moved the call'). For each it first claims the tell (tells, primary key thing and through), so the same changes are never told twice even when two runs overlap, then puts one ready action to the owner as a row of their notices (in the store their switch names, the one workflow:read-my-notices reads): when the person's next call starts within soon_minutes, a notice to call them now; else it reads the mail already sent to the address they used last (tool:find-mail) and the calendar (tool:read-calendar-events), has tool:ask-a-model draft the email, scores it with the owner's voice scorer (tool:score-writing-with-a-voice-adapter, mode draft) and the owner's phrase rules (tool:judge-against-rules), saves it as a draft in the owner's own mailbox (tool:save-a-mail-draft) and tells the owner it is there: the owner sending it is the yes, and the sent mail comes back into the history through the owner's sent-mail waiter as a sent statement, whose meaning has no tell_after, so it starts nothing. When a step of the draft fails, the notice says what changed without a draft; when a notice itself fails, the claim is given back so the next look tells it, and a saved draft that notice would have named is removed. The next call is the earliest starts_at of the person's bookings whose latest statement has no cancelled_at: the names a source's waiter row carries its values under (service-lists shape.carry). Everything the person owns (history connection, mail, calendar, voice, phrase rules, who is told) comes in on their own switch; the row names none.

payload.label: Tell me what changed for each person, with a draft ready in my mailbox
payload.job: Every five minutes, read from the person's own history which people have new changes that have settled (due_tells: each meaning's tell_after, batched per person, told once), and for each put one ready action to the owner: a call to make now when their next call starts within soon_minutes, else one email drafted in the owner's voice from the history, the mail already sent to them and the calendar, checked by the voice scorer and the owner's phrase rules and saved as a draft in the owner's own mailbox, which the owner sends himself
payload.produces: one notice to the owner for each person with settled new changes (never two for the same changes): a call to make now, or a draft saved in the owner's mailbox with its voice score and phrase findings; when the draft cannot be made, the notice says what changed without one

history.description: Where the person's history is: credential_name, the vault name of its database connection (the person's own switch input)

address_scheme.description: The history scheme whose identifiers are where an email goes (its schemes row)

soon_minutes.description: A next call starting within this many minutes is a call to make now, not an email

time_zone.description: The owner's time zone (an IANA name such as America/Chicago): every time a notice or draft names is said in it. UTC when left out

mail.description: The owner's mail account: provider and connection {connection_id}

calendar.description: The owner's calendar for tool:read-calendar-events: provider, connection {connection_id} and calendar_id (none means the main calendar)

voice.description: The owner's voice scorer settings for tool:score-writing-with-a-voice-adapter draft mode: adapter, base_model, criterion, min_paragraph_chars, decider_common_dir

phrase_rules.description: The owner's phrase rules for tool:judge-against-rules (rows {id, words})

notices.description: Where the owner's notices are kept, the store workflow:read-my-notices reads: credential_name (the vault name of that database's login, the person's own switch input) and kind (the notice kind; needs-you when none)

input.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS devices (id text PRIMARY KEY, platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('live', 'web-push', 'apns')), token text, app_build text, registered_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notices (id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, device_id text REFERENCES devices (id), title text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', body text NOT NULL DEFAULT '', url text, made_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), read_at timestamptz, acted_at timestamptz)
alter table notices add column if not exists kind text, add column if not exists key text

WITH due AS (SELECT * FROM due_tells()),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value, s.place, s.key) d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value, s.after
  FROM due d CROSS JOIN LATERAL history(d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value) h JOIN statements s ON s.id = h.id
  WHERE h.stands AND s.key IS NOT NULL AND s.after ? 'starts_at'
  ORDER BY d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value, s.place, s.key, s.at DESC, s.id DESC),
next_call AS (
  SELECT thing_scheme, thing_value, min((after ->> 'starts_at')::timestamptz) AS starts_at FROM latest
  WHERE coalesce(after ->> 'cancelled_at', '') = '' AND (after ->> 'starts_at')::timestamptz > now() GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value, d.through, d.meanings, d.words,
  (SELECT string_agg(k.value, ', ' ORDER BY k.value) FROM known_as(d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value) k WHERE k.scheme = $1::text) AS addresses,
  (SELECT m.value FROM history(d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value) h JOIN mentions m ON m.statement = h.id AND m.scheme = $1::text
     WHERE h.stands ORDER BY h.at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS address,
  (SELECT nullif(btrim(h.after ->> 'name'), '') FROM history(d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value) h
     WHERE h.after ? 'name' ORDER BY h.at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS name,
  n.starts_at AS next_call_at,
  to_char(n.starts_at AT TIME ZONE $3::text, 'Dy Mon FMDD, FMHH12:MI AM') || ' ' || $3::text AS next_call_said,
  coalesce(n.starts_at < now() + make_interval(mins => $2::int), false) AS soon,
  to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS now_at,
  to_char((coalesce(n.starts_at, now()) + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS calendar_to,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('at', h.at, 'meaning', h.meaning, 'words', h.words, 'stands', h.stands, 'said_as', h.said_as, 'after', h.after) ORDER BY h.at, h.id)
     FROM history(d.thing_scheme, d.thing_value) h)::text AS history
FROM due d LEFT JOIN next_call n ON n.thing_scheme = d.thing_scheme AND n.thing_value = d.thing_value
ORDER BY d.through

messages.content: Write the one email the owner would send this person now, in the owner's own words: short, plain, first person, no greeting formula and no sign-off beyond the owner's first name. Call the person by the name given as Name, and only that; when Name is none, use no name at all, never a name read from their address. Say what changed for them as it happened (booked, moved or cancelled one call), never more than the history shows. Read the history oldest first (what they booked, moved or cancelled), the mail already sent to them and the calendar events: say only what these show, repeat nothing already sent, and ask nothing they already answer. Name a time only as the Next call line says it: the times in the history are UTC. Answer as JSON {"subject": "...", "text": "..."}.
